task.description:
Implement the gated design in `lib/letflow/design/iss0111-with-only-this-tenant-visible-advisory-lock-fix.md` section 3 in full -- read the whole document first, it is the exact specification (lock key, acquire/release helpers, the new `with_only_this_tenant_visible!/2` body shape wrapped in one `Repo.checkout/2`, and the required change to `restore_orphaned_guard_backup_rows!/0` to acquire the same lock). Section 3.4's table states the exact acquire/release points; section 5's open question about `Repo.checkout/2`'s return-value semantics is yours to resolve empirically (verify what `Repo.checkout/2` returns and confirm `with_only_this_tenant_visible!/2`'s existing contract -- whatever it returns today -- is preserved unchanged by the new wrapper).

This is test-file-only work (`test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs`) -- no `lib/letflow/` or migration file changes. Implement exactly what the design specifies; do not improvise beyond it. If you find the design under-specifies something, report it rather than guessing.

After implementing: run the affected tests directly (`mix test test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs`) and quote real output. This fix cannot be proven correct by a single serial run alone, since the defect only manifests under CONCURRENT invocation -- construct a targeted verification: run two `mix test` invocations against `test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs`'s ISS-0060 guard test SIMULTANEOUSLY (e.g. two background shell invocations started close together) and confirm neither corrupts the other's view of `tenant_schemas` -- report exactly what you did and what you observed. If constructing genuine concurrency is impractical in this environment, say so explicitly and explain what your single-invocation run does and does not prove, per this project's own no-speculation discipline.
acceptance_criteria: test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs implements section 3's exact specification: @guard_lock_key, acquire/release helpers, the new with_only_this_tenant_visible!/2 body wrapped in one Repo.checkout/2, and restore_orphaned_guard_backup_rows!/0 acquiring the same lock in its own Repo.checkout/2
The Repo.checkout/2 return-value question (design section 5) is resolved empirically and with_only_this_tenant_visible!/2's existing return contract is confirmed preserved
mix test test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs is actually run and real output (pass/fail counts) is quoted

A genuine concurrent-invocation verification is attempted and its real result reported, or the environment's limitation is stated explicitly with what a single-invocation run does and does not establish
No file outside test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs is modified
